arxiv-2308-02232.title: Asymptotic rates of convergence for compact reversible Markov chains
arxiv-2308-02232.creator: Yue Xu, Xiuwu Zhu
arxiv-2308-02232.description: Abstract . In this paper, we establish the main term governing the rate at which a compact reversible Markov chain converges to stationarity. As an application, we obtain the sharpest estimates for the corank distributions of uniform, skew centrosymmetric, symmetric, skew-symmetric, and Hermitian matrices. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 60F17, 60J10 1.

arxiv-2310-08949.title: EasyGen: Easing Multimodal Generation with BiDiffuser and LLMs
arxiv-2310-08949.creator: Xiangyu Zhao, Bo Liu, Qijiong Liu, Guangyuan Shi, Xiao-Ming WuDepartment of Computing, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University{xiang-yu.zhao, bokelvin.liu, jyonn.liu, guang-yuan.shi}@connect.polyu.hk,xiao-ming.wu@polyu.edu.hk
arxiv-2310-08949.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xiangyu Zhao, Bo Liu, Qijiong Liu, Guangyuan Shi, Xiao-Ming WuDepartment of Computing, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University{xiang-yu.zhao, bokelvin.liu, jyonn.liu, guang-yuan.shi}@connect.polyu.hk,xiao-ming.wu@polyu.edu.hk. We present EasyGen, an efficient model designed to enhance multimodal understanding and generation by harnessing the capabilities of diffusion models and large language models (LLMs). Unlike existing multimodal models that predominately depend on encoders like CLIP or ImageBind and need ample amounts of training data to bridge modalities, EasyGen leverages BiDiffuser, a bidirectional conditional diffusion model, to foster more efficient modality interactions.

arxiv-2411-01254.title: Measurement-based Characterization of ISAC Channels with Distributed Beamforming at Dual mmWave Bands and with Human Body Scattering and Blockage
arxiv-2411-01254.creator: Yang MIAO, Minseok Kim, Naoya Suzuki, Chechia Kang, Junichi Takada
arxiv-2411-01254.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce our millimeter-wave (mmWave) radio channel measurement for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) scenarios with distributed links at dual bands in an indoor cavity; we also characterize the channel in delay and azimuth-angular domains for the scenarios with the presence of 1 person with varying locations and facing orientations.

arxiv-2411-06426.title: SequentialBreak: Large Language Models Can be Fooled by Embedding Jailbreak Prompts into Sequential Prompt Chains Warning: This paper contains certain sections may contain harmful content that may not be appropriate for all readers.
arxiv-2411-06426.creator: Bijoy Ahmed Saiem, MD Sadik Hossain Shanto, Rakib Ahsan, Md Rafi ur Rashid
arxiv-2411-06426.description: Abstract As the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) expands, so do concerns about their vulnerability to jailbreak attacks. We introduce SequentialBreak, a novel single-query jailbreak technique that arranges multiple benign prompts in sequence with a hidden malicious instruction among them to bypass safety mechanisms.

arxiv-2412-11685.title: Ultra-High-Definition Dynamic Multi-Exposure Image Fusion via Infinite Pixel Learning
arxiv-2412-11685.creator: Xingchi Chen, Zhuoran Zheng, Xuerui Li, Yuying Chen, Shu Wang, Wenqi Ren
arxiv-2412-11685.description: Abstract With the continuous improvement of device imaging resolution, the popularity of Ultra-High-Definition (UHD) images is increasing. Unfortunately, existing methods for fusing multi-exposure images in dynamic scenes are designed for low-resolution images, which makes them inefficient for generating high-quality UHD images on a resource-constrained device.

arxiv-2503-04868.title: Towards a Study of Low Energy Antiproton Annihilations on Nuclei
arxiv-2503-04868.creator: Y. Yamazaki
arxiv-2503-04868.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Y. Yamazaki. A study of antiproton annihilations at rest on thin solid targets is underway at the ASACUSA facility, which now features a dedicated beam line for slow extraction at 250 eV 250\text{\,}\mathrm{eV} . The experiment will employ new technologies, such as the Timepix4 ASICs coupled to silicon sensors, to measure the total multiplicity, energy, and angular distribution of various prongs produced in thin solid targets. A detection system consisting of seven Timepix4, covering most of the solid angle, is being constructed.

arxiv-2505-02723.title: Limit law for root separation in random polynomials
arxiv-2505-02723.creator: Marcus Michelen, Oren Yakir
arxiv-2505-02723.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marcus Michelen, Oren Yakir. Let f n f_{n} be a random polynomial of degree n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 whose coefficients are independent and identically distributed random variables. We study the separation distances between roots of f n f_{n} and prove that the set of these distances, normalized by n − 5 / 4 n^{-5/4} , converges in distribution as n → ∞ n\to\infty to a non-homogeneous Poisson point process.

arxiv-2506-22043.title: Jet precession in gamma-ray bursts: The roles of fallback accretion and disk dynamics
arxiv-2506-22043.creator: Yun-Peng Li, Da-Bin Lin, Guo-Yu Li, En-Wei Liang
arxiv-2506-22043.description: Abstract The precession phenomenon of the jet in a gamma-ray burst (GRB) is a key probe of the physics of the central engine. Previous studies generally assumed a fixed precession period when analysing the temporal profiles in GRBs; however, the dynamic evolution of the fallback process and accretion disk can significantly affect the precession behaviour.

arxiv-2512-10522.title: Disentangled and Distilled Encoder for Out-of-Distribution Reasoning with Rademacher Guarantees
arxiv-2512-10522.creator: Zahra Rahiminasab, Michael Yuhas, Arvind Easwaran
arxiv-2512-10522.description: Abstract Recently, the disentangled latent space of a variational autoencoder (VAE) has been used to reason about multi-label out-of-distribution (OOD) test samples that are derived from different distributions than training samples. Disentangled latent space means having one-to-many maps between latent dimensions and generative factors or important characteristics of an image.

pmc-10625771.title: Effect of Air Pollutants and Meteorological Factors on Daily Outpatient Visits of Allergic Rhinitis in Hohhot, China
pmc-10625771.creator: Xue Wang, Chenghua Gao, Yuan Xia, Xiaoqian Xu, Lehui Li, Yan Liu, Xing Yao, Ning Cao, Zichao Li, Xin Fang
pmc-10625771.description: ObjectiveThere is limited evidence that atmospheric pollutants are associated with the number of allergic rhinitis (AR) visits. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between atmospheric pollutants and meteorological factors and the number of daily visits for AR in Hohhot City, providing a theoretical basis for further research on the effects of atmospheric pollutants on AR.

pmc-10635631.title: Evaluation of remote teaching in master programs in the Oral Pathology and Oral Medicine during the COVID-19 pandemic. Brazilian multicentric study
pmc-10635631.creator: Fabrício Emanuel Soares de Oliveira, Nelson Pereira Marques, Daniella Reis Barbosa Martelli, Lucas Alves Trindade França, Pablo Agustin Vargas, Ludmila Ketlen Soares de Oliveira, Maria Isabela Soares de Alencar Monteiro, Maria Cássia Ferreira de Aguiar, Jean Nunes dos Santos, Janete Dias Almeida, He
pmc-10635631.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background With the COVID-19 pandemic, there was a need to adopt online teaching methods in a generalized and sudden way, a situation that led to unprecedented changes in the routine of post-graduate students and research development.

pmc-11287925.title: The mediating role of nutritional care literacy on the relationship between self-directed learning ability and nursing competence
pmc-11287925.creator: Yanhong Peng, Lingling Tan, Ke Zhang, Na Zhu, Hongjian Dong, Hong Gao
pmc-11287925.description: BackgroundNurses' nursing competence and nutritional care literacy directly affect patients' health and safety. Self-directed learning ability was pervasive throughout the entire work process of nursing work and was the basis for improving both. However, there are few studies has explored the mechanism from the perspective of nutritional care literacy.

pmc-11370256.title: Individuality and generality of intratumoral microbiome in the three most prevalent gynecological malignancies: an observational study
pmc-11370256.creator: Qin Xiao, Wen-jie Chen, Fei Wu, Xin-yi Zhang, Xia Li, Jing Wei, Ting-tao Chen, Zhao-xia Liu
pmc-11370256.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Growing evidence have indicated the crucial role of intratumor microbiome in a variety of solid tumor. However, the intratumoral microbiome in gynecological malignancies is largely unknown. In the present study, a total of 90 Han patients, including 30 patients with cancer in cervix, ovary, and endometrium each were enrolled, the composition of intratumoral microbiome was assessed by 16S rDNA amplicon high throughput sequencing. We found that the diversity and metabolic potential of intratumoral microbiome in all three cancer types were very similar.

pmc-11402645.title: Complex sphingolipid profiling and identification of an inositol-phosphorylceramide synthase in Dictyostelium discoideum
pmc-11402645.creator: Stevanus A. Listian, Anna-Carina Mazur, Matthijs Kol, Edwin Ufelmann, Sebastian Eising, Florian Fröhlich, Stefan Walter, Joost C.M. Holthuis, Caroline Barisch
pmc-11402645.description: SummaryDictyostelium discoideum is a professional phagocyte frequently used to study cellular processes underlying the recognition, engulfment, and infection course of microbial pathogens. Sphingolipids are abundant components of the plasma membrane that bind cholesterol, control membrane properties, participate in signal transmission, and serve as adhesion molecules in recognition processes relevant to immunity and infection.

pmc-11428670.title: Young Children’s Directed Question Asking in Preschool Classrooms
pmc-11428670.creator: Michelle Wong, Koeun Choi, Libby Barak, Elizabeth Lapidow, Jennifer Austin, Patrick Shafto, Elizabeth Bonawitz, John Parkinson
pmc-11428670.description: Question asking is a prevalent aspect of children’s speech, providing a means by which young learners can rapidly gain information about the world. Previous research has demonstrated that children exhibit sensitivity to the knowledge state of potential informants in laboratory settings.

pmc-11529340.title: Visual Outcome and Patient Satisfaction with Implantation of Trifocal Intraocular Lens After Radial Keratotomy
pmc-11529340.creator: Mohanna Aljindan, Hanan A Neyaz, Halah Bin Helayel, Nada N Alwohaibi, Adel Aziz Rushood
pmc-11529340.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the visual outcomes and patient satisfaction following trifocal intraocular lens (IOL) implantation after radial keratotomy (RK).MethodsThis was a retrospective chart review wherein we studied 14 eyes from 7 patients who had undergone cataract surgery and had trifocal intraocular lens (IOL) implanted in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia’s King Fahd University Hospital and Kahhal private centre.

pmc-11727919.title: The Role of Scanning Electron Microscopy in the Evaluation of Conjunctival Microvilli as an Early Biomarker of Ocular Surface Health: A Literature Review
pmc-11727919.creator: Mario Troisi, Salvatore Del Prete, Salvatore Troisi, Antonio Del Prete, Carlo Bellucci, Daniela Marasco, Ciro Costagliola
pmc-11727919.description: Microvilli are bristle-like protuberances of the plasma membrane, which express the vitality of mucous and epithelial cells; their alteration indicates a condition of cellular suffering in a predictive sense, making it possible to establish how much an inflammatory state or toxic conditions affect cellular functionality.

pmc-12512705.title: Comparison of the prevalence and linear measurements of the retromolar Canal on cone beam CT scans in Palestine and China
pmc-12512705.creator: Gang Chen, Omran Altos
pmc-12512705.description: BackgroundThe retromolar canal (RMC) is a mandibular anatomical variation containing neurovascular structures that may impact the success of anesthesia and surgical procedures in the posterior mandible. Its prevalence varies across populations, yet no prior comparative study has assessed RMC characteristics between Chinese and Palestinian populations.

pmc-12593557.title: Caring for Adolescents and Young Adults With Kidney Disease: Nephrologist Education
pmc-12593557.creator: Angelina Dixon, Anna Ostrow, Andrew Vissing, Eliza Blanchette, Jessica Kendrick
pmc-12593557.description: Rationale & ObjectiveAdolescents and young adults with chronic kidney disease experience adverse outcomes at unacceptably high rates, and the knowledge and experience of adult nephrologists in caring for young patients and patients with congenital kidney disease is a contributing factor to these adverse outcomes.

pmc-12753106.title: Evaluation of bacterial adherence and biofilm development on an anodized stainless-steel surface for the prevention of osteosynthesis-associated infections
pmc-12753106.creator: Marina Medel-Plaza, María Angeles Arenas, John J. Aguilera-Correa, Amber De Bleeckere, Aranzazu Mediero, Ignacio García, Juan J. De Damborenea, Jaime Esteban, Tom Coenye, Ana Conde
pmc-12753106.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Implant-associated infections remain a major challenge in orthopaedic surgery. This study aimed to evaluate the anti-adherent and anti-biofilm properties of a novel anodized 316L stainless-steel (A 316L SS) surface against common pathogens in osteosynthesis-associated infections (OAIs). Methods: Bacterial adherence and biofilm formation of Staphylococcus aureus, Staphylococcus epidermidis, Enterococcus faecalis, Cutibacterium acnes, Escherichia coli, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa were assessed on A 316L SS and non-anodized 316L stainless steel (Ref 316L SS). Adherence was evaluated after 90 min using fluorescence microscopy.

pmc-12978899.title: Effectiveness of Virtual Reality–Based Early Rehabilitation Strategies on Pain, Sleep, Anxiety, Balance, Cognition, and Limb Motor Function in Adult Intensive Care Unit Patients: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-12978899.creator: Fei Wu, Yunting Wu, Yana Xing, Weixin Cai, Ran Zhang
pmc-12978899.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEarly rehabilitation is vital for functional recovery in critically ill patients. Virtual reality–based early rehabilitation intervention (VR-ERI) is an emerging strategy, but evidence on its feasibility, safety, and efficacy remains inconsistent and unsynthesized.ObjectiveWe synthesized evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on the feasibility and safety of VR-ERI in adult critically ill patients and evaluated its effects on functional outcomes during intensive care unit (ICU) stay and at short-term follow-up (≤3 months post ICU).MethodsFollowing PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses)

pmc-13092611.title: Direct integration of deep learning–based GTV auto-segmentation into a clinical radiotherapy planning system
pmc-13092611.creator: Bao Ngoc Huynh, Cecilia Marie Futsaether, Oliver Tomic, Kristian Hovde Liland, Manish Kakar, Taran Paulsen Hellebust, Eirik Malinen, Einar Dale, Karsten Rydén-Eilertsen
pmc-13092611.description: Graphical abstract Introduction Accurate delineation of the Gross Tumor Volume (GTV) is crucial for radiotherapy planning [1], [2]. However, manual contouring is time-consuming and subject to both inter- and intra-observer variability [3], [4]. These variations can lead to inconsistencies in treatment planning and delivery.

pmc-13241446.title: Spatiotemporal modeling of tau aggregation following traumatic brain injury: implications for chronic traumatic encephalopathy
pmc-13241446.creator: José González-Cabrero, Carlos G. S. Cardoso, Inés Moreno-González, Ricardo J. Alves-de-Sousa
pmc-13241446.description: Chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder associated with repetitive traumatic brain injury (TBI) and characterized by abnormal tau aggregation. Although biological and clinical evidence link head trauma to tau pathology, the mechanistic pathway connecting mechanical impact to biochemical progression remains insufficiently defined.

pmc-13382585.title: Synergistic dust suppression using inorganic salt and anionic nonionic complex system
pmc-13382585.creator: Tian Wang, Baoyong Zhang, Ximing Liu, Jinghao Lv, Ningjing Feng
pmc-13382585.description: SummaryThis study examines the synergistic effect of an inorganic salt and an anionic nonionic surfactant system on the wettability and moisture retention of bituminous coal dust. Wettability and evaporation behavior were characterized using sedimentation time, contact angle, surface tension, and evaporation loss. The optimized ternary formulation markedly improved wetting performance, reducing the contact angle to 16.

pmc-13540264.title: Facial emotional expression in response to alcohol‐promoting commercials in individuals with alcohol use disorder: A pilot study
pmc-13540264.creator: Takefumi Ueno, Naho Nakayama, Shou Fukushima, Kazunori Matsuguchi, Kazuhiro Tojiki, Chenyu Qian, Shisei Tei, Hidehiko Takahashi, Junya Fujino
pmc-13540264.description: ohol‐related exposure in contemporary society, yet the psychological and emotional processes they elicit in individuals with AUD remain poorly characterized. 3 , 4 Facial expressions convey emotions, intentions, and evaluative reactions, 5 , 6 and automated facial expression analysis may provide a scalable complementary method for assessing rapid and implicit cue reactivity.

pmc-13591895.title: Indian rural women’s suicide beliefs and experiences: female suicidality as escape from and protest against a life usurped of agency
pmc-13591895.creator: Debasruti Ghosh, Sunil K Verma, Moneerah Mohammad ALmerab, Mohammed A Mamun, Satchit Prasun Mandal, Saswati Bhattacharya, Saurabh Raj
pmc-13591895.description: BackgroundSuicide remains a significant public health concern in India, with women from rural areas bearing a disproportionate burden that remains under-researched. This study aimed to explore beliefs about suicide and understandings related to suicidality among women living in rural Bihar.
